# Grupo Ferra — phase two scope

## The two streams
1. **Shift assistant, night shift.** The same tool the day shift uses, trained on how each night supervisor reports a line stop. Three weeks on the floor, no slides.
2. **Weekly dashboard.** One page for Daniela and Rodrigo every week: stops by line, time to report, who used the assistant.

## Parked
Quality photos on line 3. No lighting budget until next year. Not dropped.

## Numbers from phase one
- 31 of 38 supervisors active last week (29 at close).
- 2.3 queries per shift.
- Line-stop report: 40 minutes → 6.

## Data ownership
Everything that enters the assistant belongs to Ferra. If we stop working together, they take it in a format they can read. Clause in plain Spanish in the proposal.

## When usage drops
I review usage with Daniela every week. Two weeks without use from one supervisor and I call him. The software does not fix adoption; a person does.
